excision of a 5′-TT-3′-TT-5′-TTT-3′-3′-T-5′-T-3′ IES requires at least 72 bp of flanking DNA.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the excision of IESs is a developmentally controlled process that is highly regulated and requires flanking DNA.
the excision of IESs is a precise process, which may be similar to the excision of transposable elements, but that the IES excision system is not a transposase.

excision of the IES is dependent on the presence of the TA repeat sequences flanking the ISE.
the IESs are not transposons, but rather they are a class of site-specific DNA excision events that occur at precise sites in the genome and that require flanking sequences.
